turns.question: What were our sales on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: Sales is ambiguous, so here are both for 1 October 2026 (one day): revenue (gross, non-cancelled orders) was EUR 981.69, and net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) was EUR 964.19. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: I mean net sales, after returns.
turns.answer: Net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) was EUR 964.19 on 1 October 2026 (one day). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
